Description: Opis is Tamura’s daughter and belongs with Amage to the Alan household of Boz-Uruz. She is curious about news brought by newcomers and wants proposals explained to her directly rather than settled by elders first. Her mother’s caution offers reassurance but sometimes seems to postpone every opportunity. She can disagree with Amage without wanting outsiders to use their differences against the household. She is willing to help those close to her with immediate difficulties, but dislikes grand declarations of perpetual loyalty that conceal practical demands. What unsettles her is the possibility that an apparently minor agreement will later be presented as an arrangement she can never reconsider.
